verdict.rationale: vLLM's first-party GitHub README and site document installing via uv or pip (`uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto`) and say building from source is only for development. The docs also provide an official prebuilt Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai) on Docker Hub. Missing for 10: details on which hardware platforms and backends have prebuilt wheels versus requiring a source build, and independent or hands-on confirmation that installation works smoothly.
